resources.string: This is a testing build of Puzzlery. It contains only Solo, the Sudoku game, and it installs beside the regular app — your regular games are not affected.

Swipe to move between cells. Double-tap a cell to select it, and double-tap again for pencil marks. To enter a number: select a cell, then move down to the bottom control bar yourself and use its keys. When you finish a game, listen for the completion announcement. In Killer games, each cell\'s description gives its cage\'s total and the cells that make up the cage.
This build collects nothing — no accounts, no analytics, no network.
Feedback: open the tester page and answer the short question list.
